task: RE-CHECK OLD CONCLUSIONS (3 closed/rejected ideas from v2/v3/RESULTS)
summary: Round 33 recheck, 04:14-04:45Z 29 Sep. I made 0 Kaggle calls and used no browser; all work is local. Night probes 52-54 are PENDING at 04:14Z. I audited the ~97 earlier recheck items (rounds 2-32), ideas_29sep and the v3 value files. Only a few v3 items had never been cited by name. I picked three that bear on today's finals. (A) v3 'finals-private-emax-x138-era' said the F2 premium is <= +0.0003, 'not worth arguing about'. Recomputed for today's pair (public gap 0.004-0.005, private keeps 25-70% of it, lever spread 0.0015-0.004), the partner is worth +0.00001..+0.001 (central ~+0.0002) and counts in 1-40% of worlds. The verdict is UPHELD, with a wider upper end because private is probably a single embryo. The bigger risk has flipped. v3 feared Kaggle's auto-select; since the manual ticks {#37, #38} exist, doing nothing leaves those two as the finals. That costs ~+0.001..+0.0035, which is 5-15x the whole partner choice. So re-ticking matters far more than which partner is picked. (B) The C11 retrain family ('retraining does not pay', 10/10 refutations) is still closed for building. But the SEC n2a fine-tuned secondary is now inside 4 pool files, and probe 54 exp89p (read 07:38-08:35Z) is the first LB read of a retrained detector part in the x138 era. I wrote down in advance how that read updates C11. (C) The imissher 743222 claim (an in-notebook validator/PP sweep picks a different config on the hidden rerun) and the v3 C01 'safetail in every final' requirement: I parsed the source of all 10 finals-pool notebooks. VALIDATOR_ENABLE is 0, safetail is 34200/28800/KEEP_DIV 1, and the lever composition matches card v5 exactly. The sweep-drift risk is 0 for every candidate. No build, no submit, no rule change.

findings.what: v3 research/wf_ideas_v3/v_ensembles-and-private_finals-private-emax-x138-era (value lens REFUTED as a score idea: 'premium E[(F2-F1)+] +0.00006..+0.0005, about 0..+0.0003 over a near-copy F2, not worth arguing'; schedule lens point (b): 'if the user does not tick, Kaggle auto-selects the two best public near-copies'). This item has never been cited by any earlier recheck. WHAT CHANGED: (1) The agreed pair is {V_pub, #37 or exp75}, with a public gap g = 0.004-0.005 (V_pub 0.959+ vs #37 0.954, exp75 pending). (2) R29-RC-B: private keeps ~25-70% of a public step. R29-RC-C: private is probably ONE embryo, so the private lever spread s is wider (0.0015-0.004). (3) The user has ticked {#37 56563521, #38 56563534} by hand, so Kaggle's auto-select never runs. Doing nothing therefore leaves {#37, #38} as the finals. RECOMPUTED (normal D = partner - V_pub on private, mu = -g*rho): E[D+] ranges from +0.005e-3 to +1.15e-3, and P(the partner is the file that counts) from 0.01 to 0.40. Central case (g 0.005, rho 0.5, s 0.0025): +0.21e-3, P 0.16. Leaving {#37, #38} ticked loses E[V_pub - #37] = g*rho = +1.0..+3.5e-3 plus that premium, which is 5-15x the whole partner decision. NEW VERDICT: UPHELD in size. The partner is tail insurance worth ~+0.0002 in expectation, and its upper end (+0.001 at s 0.004) is higher than v3 said because of the single-embryo spread. The schedule risk is INVERTED. The failure mode is no longer auto-select but the manual ticks going stale. That makes re-ticking the most valuable user action today, ahead of the P1-vs-P3 choice.

findings.what: Two old finals-safety claims. (1) s_merge browser_findings_not_covered and v3 FINAL_REPORT l.263 (imissher 743222): 'x138-type in-notebook PP sweeps score DIFFERENT train stems on the hidden rerun, so the config behind an LB score can differ; never ship x138's validator/PP sweep ON'. (2) v3 (e)/(f): 'C01 (safetail) in every build; x138 verbatim is not a safe final'. The earlier check (ideas_29sep/mine_discussions.notes.md l.23) covered only 7 files, and no recheck ever audited the whole pool's composition. WHAT CHANGED: 5 more files joined the pool since 25 Sep (exp89l/p/q/r/s), and the card now labels files by lever count. MEASURED (parsed each notebook's env cell): all 10 finals-pool notebooks have BIOHUB_VALIDATOR_ENABLE 0. The pool is exp58 #37, exp70g, exp75, exp85a, exp87a and exp89l/p/q/r/s. The code then takes the else branch 'SWEEP: validator unavailable -- keeping the base configuration.' (exp85a joined code ~l.5067 and l.5790), so no file has a config that depends on train stems. All 10 also have REPAIR_DEADLINE_S 34200, DIVINS_DEADLINE_S 28800, DEGRADE_KEEP_DIV 1 and lowrefine. Lever composition: DIVINS_CAP is 4 in #37 and exp75 and 6 elsewhere. ILP_DIVISION_WEIGHT/READMIT_MIN_SCORE are 1.2/0.965 in #37, exp70g and exp75, and 0.4/0.94 in exp85a to exp89s. DIS 2.25 appears only in exp89q/r/s. CI (ENABLE 1, ALPHA 0.5, MAX_UM 3.0) is in exp75, exp87a, exp89l and exp89r. SEC n2a is in exp89l/p/q/r. This matches card v5's fixed_refs/token_refs and its lever counts exactly. exp56 (x138 verbatim) is the only file with 27000 and without safetail, and it is never a final. NEW VERDICT: UPHELD and SATISFIED. The hidden-rerun config-drift risk is zero for every candidate. Any private-vs-public difference between our files therefore comes from levers only, not from sweeps or guards.
